title: Kompass: Family, children, education & work
tip: Read the Kompass first: it gives you the key facts behind every question in this block.

exercises.title: Kompass: Family, children, education & work (1/2)
exercises.body: The Grundgesetz meets daily life. Family law: only **civil marriage at the Standesamt** counts legally; **monogamy** only; divorce needs a lawyer + the **Trennungsjahr**; at **18** (volljährig) parents lose legal say; at **14** criminal responsibility (strafmündig) begins, under juvenile law.

exercises.title: Kompass: Family, children, education & work (2/2)
exercises.body: Children's rights: **gewaltfreie Erziehung** (no hitting, even parents), **Schulpflicht** with attendance duty, legal claim to a **Kindergartenplatz** from age 3, and the **Jugendamt** as helper *and* protector of children. Work life: **Mutterschutz**, **Elterngeld** (apply, nothing is automatic), **Betriebsrat**, **Kündigungsfrist**, the **BIZ** for apprenticeships, **Abendgymnasium** and **Volkshochschule** for second chances, lifelong learning as the labor market's rule. You're living half of this block already. Kindergeld, Kita from August, a work contract in March.

exercises.title: Kompass auf Deutsch: Familie, Kinder, Bildung & Arbeitswelt
exercises.body: Eltern erziehen, der Staat hilft: Elterngeld (Antrag!), Kita-Anspruch ab 3, Jugendamt bei Problemen. Schulpflicht; volljährig mit 18, strafmündig ab 14, Religionsmündigkeit 14. Zweiter Bildungsweg: Abendgymnasium, VHS. Arbeit: Mutterschutz, Betriebsrat, Kündigungsfrist.
